notes.title: The Monster Arcade Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/2fc8439244eadbeb27a5082ea1cd762b72a36c6d.png[/img]

Hello Creators,

Have you ever wished you could create your very own arcade? Or a monster house? Or a monster-themed arcade? Well now you can in our latest update, which also adds some fixes and improvements. As always, thank you for playing Creativerse, and enjoy!

[list]
[*]Four new Arcade Cabinet variants of stations
[list]
[*]Purple Cabinet & Base - Processor
[*]Dark Blue Cabinet & Base - Forge
[*]Light Blue Cabinet & Base - Crafting
[*]Red Cabinet & Base - Cooking
[*]Base Blocks for the above unlock on the stations themselves (e.g. Arcade 
Processor Base unlocks on Arcade Processor)
[/list][*]New plain variant of the Retro Arcade Carpet, including shape variants (slab, slope, slice, etc.)
[*]Five new Monster Blocks
[list]
[*]Monster Eye
[*]Monster Scales
[*]Small Monster Scales
[*]Monster Fur
[*]Gelatinous Block
[*]Recipes added to "monster" type mob drops (e.g. Miru, Thing)
[*]Shape variants included for all the above except the eye
[/list][*]Six new Figurines (added to Thing's loot table)
[list]
[*]5 Ghost Figures (common)
[*]Pumpkiru figure (rare)
[/list][*]New Pointed Hat for pets (added to drop tables for higher-tier treasure chests, along with pet bowties, etc)
[*]New world settings to change the growth times of crops, queen bees, mushrooms and trees

notes.title: Creativerse Update — Aug 2023
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/a4a0c0f5f5c1eddb4e1271359e903773f5f154fb.jpg[/img]

Hello Creators,

We’re back with another decent sized Creativerse update! This time we’ve focused a lot on quality of life improvements, with an overhauled settings menu that finally unshackles post-processing effects like depth of field, color grading, ambient occlusion, and more, allowing you to make them permanent (like in the featured screenshot). There’s a new Vending Machine item that you can customize to allow trades of any item for another item, so if you want to make the entire Lumite Armor set cost 5 dirt blocks, you sure can. And there’s a ton of other stuff like this – so please do check out what may be our longest patch notes ever!

[b]Map:[/b]
[list]
New Map Warping feature! Warp to any location by clicking on the map view while holding the Sprint key…[list]
[*]Works at both zoom levels
[*]Works regardless of map fog
[*]You can customize the altitude at which you are teleported from the game settings
Requires the following:[list]
[*]The player must enable it in the game settings (in Misc tab)
[*]The player must have access to Creator Mode and the `/warp` command in the world[/list][/list]
[*]Added world coordinates in map view as you hover the mouse around
[/list]
[b]New Mob variant:[/b]
[list]
[*]Night Truffl!
[/list]
[b]Game settings / preferences:[/b]
[list]
[*]Completely new settings interface!
[*]Settings menu now includes all preferences, including post-processing options only available in Photo Mode or via chat commands or manually altering a configuration file
[*]For example, you can now have on by default settings like tilt-shift, the kuwahara effect, high contrast, vignettes, etc.
[*]Added an editor for custom paint values
[*]Allow the settings window to be manually resized
[*]Increased max Target Framerate from 120 to 240
[*]Fixed Shadow Quality changes not getting applied on the fly
[*]Added setting to disable map view movement with forward / back / left / right bindings to allow unusual bindings such as primary mouse button > forward (interface buttons will still work)
[*]Added horizontal / vertical / sprint settings to affect movement speed when hovering in Creator Mode
[*]Added setting to customize Creator Mode first / third person reach distance (i.e. how far you can pull / place blocks)
[*]Added setting to allow long reach distance for wiring in Creator Mode (defaults to false)
[*]Added settings to alter Camera Drone acceleration, drag, and sprint multipliers
[*]Added horizontal / vertical sensitivity settings for the glider (separate settings for mouse and alpha controller)
[*]Added setting to hide the Gliding Controls while gliding
[*]Added settings to make crouch-descending optional:[list]
[*]While swimming (defaults to true)
[*]While climbing (defaults to false)
[*]While hovering in Creator Mode (defaults to false)[/list]
[*]Added settings to enable / disable block copying:[list]
[*]While in Survival (defaults to false)
[*]While in Creator Mode (defaults to true)[/list]
[*]Added setting to enable Map Warping (see New Map Warping feature section below)
[*]Added altitude setting to be used by Map Warping
[/list]
[b]New Vending Machine / Shop Catalogs feature:[/b]

[*]New Vending Machine block
[*]Each placed Vending Machine can be set to use one or more Catalogs

notes.title: The Collectables Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567866/b0a1e9bbf09c19470bd85e8625c1b67d54999bc2.png[/img]

Hello Creators!

Turns out Thing is quite the collector, and now its collection can be yours. These shiny new figurines — which feature your favorite Creativerse mobs like Pigsy, Leafi, Chizzard, Rambeau, Rockster, Keepa, and more — will look great in your builds! So if you're feeling adventurous, head down to the Corruption Layer and fight or tame some Things to start collecting. It won't be easy but it will be worth it.

In addition, we have some new items and a bunch of improvements, including a big overhaul to loot from treasure chests, which are now way more rewarding. We've added the ability to customize the length of timers in advanced world options, so now you can process and forge everything in 1 second if you like. There’s several new chat commands that add some useful tinkering abilities. And more!

This update also removes the ability to migrate your old worlds (...end of an era). Until next time...stay creative!

Thing now has a chance to drop collectable figures straight from its amazing collection of things!

notes.title: Version Bump!
notes.notes:
Apologies, but we forgot to bump the version number for the last hotfix, which would allow clients to join servers that may not be on the same data, and this can cause unpredictable issues. So this update is merely a version bump. Servers will need to update to be joinable again.

More to come later

notes.title: The Under the Hood Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Creators!
 
You may have noticed that the team has put out a steady stream of patches up until now, ironing out the wrinkles and swatting bugs left and right. Today's update is similar but on a bigger scale, with particular focus on optimizing the game's performance. This included an engine upgrade (Unity 2018), rebuilding old code, lots of tinkering and elbow grease, and extensive testing on the worst, most min-spec PCs we could find. As a result, the Under the Hood Update offers a smoother, more optimized experience, along with a bunch of smaller improvements and bugfixes. It’s certainly not the end of performance fixes, but it's a pretty good foundation for more.

	
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]Updates, Additions, and Tweaks:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Major Engine upgrade to Unity 2018[/b]
[list]
[*] Assorted bug fixes related to engine upgrade
[*] New graphics quality settings
[/list]
[*] Mud is now craftable using Water and Dirt
[*] Water no longer requires any mining cell to be pulled
[*] Max view radius has been increased
[*] Lava and Corrupted Water can now be pulled by Diamond mining cell
[*] Hidden Temple and Medieval Chests no longer require Stone mining cell to pull 
[*] Selection highlight in Action Bar is a little wider and easier to see
[*] Gift Boxes are rotatable in any direction
[*] Pet information window is simultaneously dismissed with its associated pet
[*] Lilly pads can now be put in containers
[*] Automatic text censoring logic has been improved to try and help reduce the number of false positives, i.e “Grass”
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Pet bubbles render on top of water correctly
[*] Glowing mushrooms are glowing again
[*] Pets are properly dirty after harvesting (get the soap ready!)
[*] New adventures show up under the New category
[*] Fixed a few issues with Pets disappearing (i.e in some instances, pets that were told to “Stay” would either disappear or wind up clumped together)
[*] Fixed a few issues related to player names (such as when a user is banned)
[*] Decogorgeous Door disappears at the same distance as other doors
[*] Blocky the Snowman is visible when placed in a container
[*] Fixed snow caps spreading and showing up inconsistently (how rude!)
[*] Fixed issues related to recipes not carrying over between worlds properly
[*] Magic Snow Globe should no longer create snow when placed in displays
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented purchase of block kits for a moss block-customized blueprint
[*] All firework types give off sound effects
[*] Sleeping in a bed for the first time no longer triggers a “New Area Discovered” message/ reveals a grid on the map
[*] Mobs can now be attacked while they are in a teleporter
[*] Customizing Curtains no longer create error blocks around them
[*] Frozen Container no longer mysteriously hides itself after leaving and returning to an area
[*] /setspawn should work again
[*] @ and other symbols can now be correctly used in text fields regardless of the keyboard layout
[*] Safe walk now prevents players from walking off slopes
[*] Player preferences are now tied to your Steam account instead of the client
[/list]


From Jeremy:[i] "Small easter egg, when you save your costume customization in the menu, a high res screen of your character is saved to C:\Users\your user\AppData\LocalLow\PlayfulCorp\Creativerse\avatar[/i]

[*]Gauntlet smash damage scales with your weapon’s power

[*]Use Gauntlet Smash any time you have 75% or more stamina. 
All your remaining stamina will be consumed for this impressive attack.[/list]

[*]A wide range of player animation improvements and polish

notes.title: The Blueprint Revolution Update!
notes.notes:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/80jSabH.jpg]
Greetings, Creators!

In the two years since we introduced the very first blueprints (Pigsy Statue 4 LIFE~!), we've carefully kept our blueprint creation tools under lock and key here at Playful HQ. Today, for the first time, we're unleashing those tools and putting the power of blueprint creation in your hands.

The Blueprint Revolution Update adds Steam Workshop support to Creativerse to give players access to unlimited blueprint content published by our brilliant community. You’ll be able to browse through an always-expanding library of community blueprints to spark your creativity and revolutionize your world.

Think you’ve got a build that’s blueprint-worthy? Craft up a Capture Block (they come in a few sizes) and use it to generate your own blueprint to publish directly to the Workshop!

And the Blueprint Revolution wouldn't be complete without a fully streamlined and polished blueprint experience. Upgraded visuals, better menus and interfaces, and full 3D blueprint previews (including custom swapped blocks) round out this revolutionary set of changes.

The wait is over -- launch Creativerse NOW to join the Blueprint Revolution!

[h1]New Features and Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]New! Steam workshop support for player blueprints
[list]
[*]Craft capture stones (consumable) to capture small, medium, and large blueprints
[*]Publish blueprints directly to the Steam workshop from within the game
[/list]
[*]Blueprint system overhaul
[list]
[*]New blueprint placement visualizations
[*]New simplified flow for blueprint activation and kit purchase
[*]New advanced options for blueprints (under Settings / Controls)
[list]
[*]Allow blueprint override placement - allow placement of incorrect blocks in blueprints (also works by holding shift on placement)
[*]Show all blueprint previews - shows previews for the unactivated cornerstones of other players
[/list]
[*]All blueprint cornerstones now free to craft
[*]Cornerstones no longer included with blueprint kits
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Minor improvements to inventory scrolling
[*]Camera UI reskinned to match other UI elements
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]“Last Online” time / date for player lists now correct
[*]Fix for broken sound on industrial switch
[*]Red, Blue, and Yellow Pet Bow Ties now correctly have a chance to drop

notes.notes:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/tUJ59vV.png]
Welcome, Creators!

Early Access may be over but the ride is just getting started. Grab a friend and join the fun -- Creativerse is officially LAUNCHED!

We're kicking off launch by releasing a top community-requested Creativerse feature: [b]stair and roof corner blocks[/b]! Plus we've leveled up the game with our usual fleet of fixes, optimizations, and balance tweaks. (You spoke. We heard. Super extractors just got super-charged.)

Whether you're a Creati-veteran or discovering the world of Creativerse for the very first time (in which case, try to find some shelter before nightfall - you’ll thank us later), we're thrilled to have you along for the ride!

P.S. For a glimpse at what comes next, don't miss [url=http://playfulcorp.tumblr.com/post/160269493404/our-bold-vision-for-the-future-of-creativerse]this blog post[/url] by our game director.

[h1]New Features and Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]New corner blocks!
[list]
[*]Process crafted stairs and roofs in the processor to make inside and outside corners
[/list]
[*]New placemat item
[list]
[*]Use to place and arrange decorative items on most flat surfaces
[/list]
[*]New block bundles
[list]
[*]Medieval Pack
[*]Hidden Temple Pack
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Memory usage & performance improvements
[*]Added teleporter tutorial screen
[*]Additional protection against some exploits
[*]Balance adjustments
[list]
[*]Super extractor now returns 3.5x base ore value (up from 3)
[*]Forge time for iron ore is 20 seconds (down from 30)
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed most cases of missing visual chunks
[*]Fix for visual “missing block” when half-pulling other blocks
[*]Fix for broken block outlines when building blueprints
[*]Fixed low light level of medieval torches
[*]Purchased bundles now show up properly when inventory page first opened
[*]Fixed bad shader on medieval throne
[*]Medieval door can now be wired
[*]Tweaked loadscreen to fix minor visual issue
[*]Fixed minor issues with missing text strings for some items
[/list]

notes.title: The “You” Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Pc2i5Ix.jpg[/img]

If you’ve been paying attention to our recent UI changes, it should come as no surprise that a fresh coat of paint for the main menu was long overdue. It now has a polished, simplified layout featuring you (or more accurately your player character). It also has our new Public Worlds gallery where you can find and join worlds looking for newcomers, or set your own world as “Public” to list your world and recruit new adventurers. Plus, you can “like” your favorite worlds and use our improved search to find whatever special corner of the Creativerse speaks to you.

If you’ve been paying attention to us on social media, you’ll know we recently asked what stairs, slabs and slopes YOU would like to see us add. If you’ve been paying attention, R36 is dedicated to you players, especially those who pay attention. Thank you for the attention! As always, please share your feedback with us…

notes.title: R34 - Crafting Revamp and Even More Bugfixes!
notes.notes:
R34 fine-tunes Creativerse with significant under-the-hood improvements and bugfixes, alongside a totally souped-up crafting system!

Pull up your crafting menu to discover the most impactful changes. The redesigned crafting UI (the first step in a broader UI revamp) features a search function and improved sorting, plus a brand new way to unlock recipes.

Don’t delay - hop in and take Creativerse R34 for a ride today!

[h1]New Features and Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]Revised crafting system (replacing old prerequisite system)!
[list]
[*]UI visual overhaul for crafting panel
[*]Search and categories added to crafting panel
[*]New unlock requirements for all ingame blocks and items
[*]Improved information and hints about how to get certain items
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added “shift-click” shortcut to crafting screen to craft five items at once
[*]Dropped bags now properly land on pressure plates
[*]The Thing now path-finds as a 2 block tall mob
[*]Mud is now a tier 1 block
[*]Load times improved when teleporting
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Substantial improvements for problems with missing chunks in the world
[*]Additional bugfixes for liquid simulations destroying terrain
[*]Fixed nonfunctional /ignore, /ignoreall, and /unignore commands
[*]Fixed bombs exploding immediately when thrown if player is standing on slabs
[*]Stunned mobs no longer freeze in midair
[*]Spawning system fixes
[/list]

[list]
[*]New advanced claim option: Fire Enabled
[list]
[*]Unchecking this option prevents fire from spreading into the claim, and also prevents anything within the claim from catching fire
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Pro membership now can be bought as Steam DLC (as well as in the game).
[list]
[*]Existing pro memberships will have the DLC version automatically granted
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fix for players with too many Steam friends being unable to join worlds
[*]Fixes for liquid simulation destroying blocks
[*]Lighting bugfixes and improvements
[*]Fixes for non-surface blocks sometimes not mining properly
[/list]

notes.title: Creativerse R32 and the Raiders of the Hidden Temple (and Bugfixes)
notes.notes:
Howdy folks. R32 is a smaller update than usual, but it packs a quite a punch. There’s a lot of cool stuff to check out in the store, like new Hidden Temple accessories and content, plus two new related blueprints, all of which are guaranteed to have you itching for a [url=https://media.giphy.com/media/3o72FbLCvQlIa43jOM/giphy.gif] bag of sand[/url]. Aside from that, there’s a whole slew of improvements and bugfixes that’ll make your Creativersing much more pleasant.

P.S. Learn some unusual building techniques in our our new tips video.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1y6zZFbStf4
[h1]New Features and Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]Lots of new Hidden Temple accessories and content -- check the store for details!
[*]Two new blueprints: Hidden Temple and Majestic Hidden Temple!
[list]
[*]NOTE: the default versions of these blueprints require premium blocks to complete, though you may customize them just like any other blueprint
[/list]
[*]Added help button to main menu leading to new external website content
[/list]
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]All crafted blocks can now be pulled with any gauntlet
[*]All recipe packs in the store now include free stacks of sample blocks, so players can start building right away
[*]Vines and moss can now be used as fuel in the forge
[*]Revised mining cell icon artwork
[*]Pet icons added to local map
[*]Improved messaging when attempting to purchase something in the store when coins are low
[*]Improved UI for world admin commands like /ban and /kick
[list]
[*]Admin command UI now shows time and date players were last online
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fix for blueprint hint blocks not rendering along certain chunk boundaries
[*]Fix for enemies attacking through doors and walls
[*]Fixed some issues with AI pathing over fences
[*]Fix for players with ‘visitor’ permissions being able to interact with some objects
[*]Using the ‘/party invite’ menu no longer disables settings menu buttons
[*]Adobe bricks now work in decorative containers and blueprints
[/list]

notes.title: Update: Upcoming change to blueprint system
notes.notes:
Greetings, Creatifolks.

We wanted to give the community a quick heads-up about the future of one of our favorite Creativerse features: blueprints! We think blueprints are a lot of fun, and decided they’d be even better if they were free for everyone to enjoy. So effective R31, [b]all blueprints will be free[/b], though you’ll have the option to buy all the blocks if you want to get started building instantly. We’ll also be adding a bunch of new blueprints to the mix.

To prepare for the change, we're disabling blueprint purchases until the R31 update, which is a week or so away. We appreciate your patience as we work to give blueprints the democracy they deserve!

notes.title: Creativerse R27 -- The Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
UI be a little more helpful. Night be a little less dangerous. Bugs be a little less buggy.

That’s R27 in a nutshell.

Behind the scenes, we moved to a new office, took time off for the holidays and have been laying the groundwork for features that won’t be ready for a while. In other words, we acknowledge R27 isn’t as meaty as you’re used to. R28 will have more stuff!

P.S. We’ve slowly been upgrading our [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/280790]store page[/url] over the past couple months -- new banners, screenshots, game descriptions, etc. Let us know what you think!


[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]More detail in UI item description
[*]Better block placement behavior
[list]
[*]Added a player “nudge” when placing a nearby block (allows for placing blocks closer to your feet)
[*]Improved messaging when blocks can’t be placed
[/list]
[*]Nighttime in forest, woodland, and plains biomes less dangerous 
[*]Feedback when trying to learn recipes that are already known
[*]Compass death skull now pings upon respawning
[*]Art - flames added to torch icons
[*]Art - Janky House icon now properly a blueprint
[*]Rimecones and snow cubes show up when placed on shelves
[*]Fences no longer connect to wildflowers
[*]Added Hotfoot harvesting sounds
[*]Server improvements
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fix for fluid faces not rendering when adjacent to glass
[*]Fix for iron gate rapidly opening and closing when in open state
[*]Beeswax now an option in custom blueprint block swaps
[*]“Ghost block” pulling fixed
[*]Lily pads can now be targeted
[*]Beams & torches sort properly behind liquids
[*]Fix for Rockster & Pigsy sliding while “powering up”
[*]Lighting fixes while underneath large surface structures
[*]Fix for world list visual hiccups on main menu
[*]Fix for rare bug that would not grant coins on coin pack purchase
[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*]Holiday recipe drops disabled 
[*]Janky House no longer granted to new players
[/list]

notes.title: Update: Upcoming store and game downtime
notes.notes:

Then, on Wednesday morning we’ll have extended downtime -- at least 4 hours -- as we work to get things set up on our end. Sorry for the delay, but as consolation when we go back online your bonus coins and early access supporter gifts will be waiting for you, and your friends will have one less excuse to not join the fun.

notes.title: Creativerse R4 -- The Arctek Update
notes.notes:
Hello Creatifriends,

There's a couple cool things to talk about with this release. First, as mentioned earlier, this version has no store or mojo, and we've removed the ability to skip any timers. They are now part of the game and will no longer be tied to pay to play mechanics. To further ensure this feels like a step forward, we've re-balanced all the timers, starting with removing them for the Crafting Station and shortening many of them for the Forge, Processor and Extractor.

And in this release we're replacing a lot of art with a new style we call Arctek. You saw a smidge of this last time with the new teleporters, but you'll see it all over the place this time. Stations, beacons, touchstones, and more have been recalibrated with the new style. Let us know what you think!

Here's all the nitty gritty details you'll notice in this version...


[h1]New Features and Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]Minimized all timers on crafting station
[*]“Finish now” button removed
[*]Mojo & Store disabled (temporarily)
[*]Substantial art revisions to stations and other objects
[*]New corrupted stone wall recipe & block
[*]Additional journal and data chip content
[*]Additional audio effects
[*]New rare loot drops
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Extractor, forge, and processor timers balance overhaul
[*]Performance and memory optimizations
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Death statue changes to prevent destruction of other entities (like teleporters)
[*]Death statue automatically added to inventory when empty (can still be placed back into the world for decoration)
[*]Additional inventory loss bulletproofing
[*]Drag-and-drop improvements and bulletproofing
[*]Inventory and storage panel generally more robust
[*]Fix for missing icons and text for corrupted blocks
[*]Multiblock support for horizontal multiblocks (notably beds)
[*]Light attenuation fix for glass and windows
[*]Fix for Mac issue with certain brands of mice
[*]Corrupted creatures will now burn in daylight
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]Rapid right-clicking and dragging in inventory or storage screen will leave inventory icons permanently onscreen. Fixed by logging in and out of the world.
[*]Still no stack-splitting or stack joining, and still no quickbar available on processor and forge screens. (Next time!)
[/list]

Happy building!

notes.title: Creativerse Release 3 Is Here
notes.notes:
Hey Creativersers,

Good news! We weren’t kidding about getting updates out to you sooner! That does mean there’s less new content in this update, but it also means we’ll have more stuff for you just around the corner. Here’s what you’ll see in today’s update:

[h1][b]New Features and Content[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Shadows![/b] The sun now casts shadows on everything in the game, adding a sense of depth and beauty.
[*][b]Additional music.[/b] Let us know what you think!
[/list]

[h1][b]Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Spectre enemy removed.[/b] We heard from enough of you about your frustration with this guy, so we’re benching it for a season to see if we can improve it.
[*][b]Increased chance for Queen Bees to form beeswax.[/b] Because you can always use more beeswax.
[*][b]Less randomness in fire simulation and fire spread reduced.[/b] We pacified our inner pyromaniac and made fire a little less crazy.
[*][b]Shadow options added to visual options.[/b] You can disable shadows for better performance on older machines.
[*][b]Visual improvements for mobs.[/b] Now your cursor outlines instead of highlights mobs and the loot bag FX is improved.
[/list]

[h1][b]Bugfixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Fix for lost touchstones.[/b] If you’re missing a touchstone and have room in your inventory, we’ll give you one.
[*][b]Added back in recipes accidentally removed in R2.[/b] Fireworks, Salt, Asphalt and others are back — sorry about that!
[*][b]Fix for broken crafting station animation.[/b] Finally, it works like the other stations.
[*][b]Armor effects now properly disabled when armor removed.[/b] Though it was a pretty good cheat while it lasted :)
[*][b]Bugfix for TNT sometimes not exploding in multiplayer.[/b] We found all the dud TNT bombs and threw ‘em out.
[*][b]Water sim throttling to prevent severe performance hits.[/b] Do more with water with less lag!
[*][b]Rapid sun movements at dawn / dusk fixed.[/b] We cured the sun’s epilepsy!
[*][b]Missing geometry on fence objects fixed.[/b]
[*][b]General performance & stability improvements.[/b]
[/list]

[h1][b]Major known Issues[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Changes to visual options require a game restart to apply.[/b]
[*][b]Mouse movement issues when exiting UIs on some Mac & mouse combinations.[/b]
[*][b]UI issues from R2 still not fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*]Single-click selection on forge and processor is not working. Either double-click or drag to queue up items in those stations
[*]Items on the quickbar are not accessible in the crafting station, forge, and processor.
[*]Minor quickbar and drag-and-drop bugs (generally cleaned up by closing your inventory).
[/list]
[/list]

And in case you missed it, here’s the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/280790/discussions/0/613936673553589581/]notes for Release 2.[/url]
